Name: Shipping Bin Label (Fixed - Continued - Better Summary - Tooltip - 1.6)
Author: DylanJames
Description:
[center][url=https://ko-fi.com/dylanjamesxyz][img]https://github.com/doodlum/nexusmods-widgets/blob/main/Ko-fi_40px_60fps.png?raw=true[/img][/url][/center]


[b][size=4]REQUIREMENTS[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
⧉ㅤ[url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
[b][size=4]DESCRIPTION[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
Display a label with the total value of items in the Shipping Bin when you hover over it.
Configurable to only show up if you have purchased the "[url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Price_Catalogue]Price Catalogue[/url]" from the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Bookseller]Bookseller[/url].

This is my own "modernized" take on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18992]Shipping Bin Summary[/url] with less bugs and technically more features.
It is compatible with 1.6, the label doesn't show up in random places on other maps, and is way simpler.
